apps.description:
Tell your family’s fullest story, one text at a time.

As seen on ABC’s Shark Tank, Qeepsake helps busy parents save beautiful memories of their little one, from pregnancy to school years. Easily journal photos and milestones via text or the Qeepsake app. Order printed albums to hold your memories in a real photo book.

Qeepsake sends you age-appropriate question prompts for your little one, even in the earliest stages of pregnancy. Simply reply to a text message and a new memory is saved in your child’s journal!

It’s never too late to start! Not only can you backdate entries from earlier memories, but Qeepsake also offers prompts for every journey. Maternity to adoption, IVF to school years, babyhood to parenting—journal every moment with Qeepsake.

Add more to your saved memories! With the Qeepsake app, you can:

- Upload more photos & videos
- Edit your journal entries
- Build photo collages
- Preview and order your family album

Qeepsake instantly turns your family, baby, kid-related moments, and Qeepsake memories into a personally crafted hardcover or softcover photo book filled with all your pictures and journal entries. Cherish and share your new photo album for years to come!

You can preview your family’s picture album, baby photo book, and memory journal anytime using the Qeepsake app. Spend less time fussing with complicated book editing software and get back to making new memories with your family!

Capture, record, and share childhood moments without missing a single one. Easily save every moment of your child’s life, pregnancy through childhood, with Qeepsake.

Qeepsake Features:

Save Moments & Memories

- Qeepsake sends you personalized, age-informed question prompts for any number of children
- Qeepsake automatically saves your photos and memories into a beautifully formatted baby book or family photo album
- Share access with your spouse or other contributors to add to your child’s journal
- Weekly recap emails of all your new journal entries to share with friends & family

Easy Photo Journals

- Text your photos and memories to save them
- Build photo collages effortlessly
- Create beautifully formatted books based off your photos and entries automatically

Milestones for Any Occasion

- Use Qeepsake to make a maternity, baby, or family journal
- Save the precious firsts in your child’s life
- Capture key moments in your pregnancy
- Journal milestones and memories as your child grows
- Create a photo book to share when they’re older

We text you prompts, you text us the memories you want to hold tight. Subscription Pricing and Terms: Unlock full access to Qeepsake’s digital features (unlimited photo storage, unlimited journal entries, video uploads, a larger and more frequent set of question prompts, question prompts via multiple channels (including SMS), the ability to answer missed questions, backdate journal entries, and more) with auto-renewing monthly and yearly subscription membership options.

If you select an auto-renewing subscription membership option, payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and your Qeepsake subscription will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your credit card will be charged for renewal through your iTunes account within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.

Turn off an auto-renewing subscription at any time from your iTunes Account Settings. Refunds will not be issued for any unused portion of the term. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription where applicable. For more information on our terms of service and privacy policy, visit https://app.qeepsake.com/terms OR https://app.qeepsake.com/privacy

Support: Loving the Qeepsake app? Please leave a review! Want to help us improve the app? Email [support@qeepsake.com](mailto:support@qeepsake.com).

A better way to remember.

Tinybeans is a private family journal that helps you capture the everyday magic—first steps, messy meals, bedtime giggles—and keeps all your family memories organized for you, without adding to your mental load. It’s built by parents and designed for real life: small moments, saved when you have a minute, that slowly add up to something you’ll feel so grateful to have captured, whether you’re reminiscing in your private digital journal or flipping through a beautiful photo book.

Capture. Organize. Share. Keep.
1) CAPTURE YOUR WAY
• Easily upload baby memories (and beyond) in the moment, or bulk upload in batches.

2) ORGANIZE AUTOMATICALLY
• Moments are automatically organized and sorted by date.

3) SHARE PRIVATELY
• You choose who follows along, by invite only.

4) BRING IT TO LIFE
• Turn your memories into beautiful photo books in minutes, right in the app.

Choose from two plans:
1) TINYBEANS (FREE)
• 20 uploads per month
• Secure family sharing
• 5GB of storage space

2) TINYBEANS+
• Unlimited uploads
• High-quality videos up to 5 minutes
• 200GB of storage space
• Ad-free experience
• 2nd user account to share
• Priority support
• Secure family sharing

Start your free two-week trial of Tinybeans+ today.

Why millions of parents love us
1) YOU OWN YOUR MEMORIES: Every photo and video you upload belongs to you. 

2) YOU HAVE FULL CONTROL OVER ACCESS: Only the people you invite can see your family’s journal. 

3) YOUR DATA ISN’T FOR SALE: We use your information to improve your experience, never to sell it.

4) BUILT BY PARENTS, FOR FAMILIES: Tinybeans was created with the same care you bring to your decisions. 

5) HERE FOR THE LONG HAUL: From newborn days to teenage years, we’re committed to supporting your family over time.

Because the little moments add up fast—and future you will be so happy you saved them.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings.

Questions/feedback? Please reach out to us at info@tinybeans.com. We love to hear from you. Tinybeans website: https://tinybeans.com

Family Conversations turns dinner into your family's favorite part of the day. Each night, discover a thoughtful conversation question designed to spark meaningful dialogue with your kids — no screens, no distractions, just real connection.

Choose from 8 unique categories — What If, Would You Rather, Tell Me a Time When, What Do You Think About, Family History, Hard Questions, Dream Big, and Gratitude & Noticing — each carefully crafted to build a different cognitive skill like critical thinking, moral reasoning, and emotional awareness.

FEATURES:
• Tonight's Question — A fresh conversation starter every evening
• Shuffle Button — Instantly jump to a random question for spontaneous fun
• Favorites — Save your favorite questions and revisit them anytime
• Share Questions — Share conversation starters to social media with friends and family
• Daily Reminders — Set a custom notification so you never miss family dinner
• Age-Appropriate — Questions tailored for ages 3–17, with developmental age support
• Go Deeper — Tap to unlock a more challenging version of any question
• Follow-Up Prompts — Built-in conversation helpers when kids need a nudge
• Quote Journal — Save and share your children's most memorable answers
• Dinner Streaks — Track your family's conversation habit
• Table Mode — A beautiful dark interface designed for the dinner table
• Apple Watch — Browse questions right from your wrist
• iPad Optimized — Full support for larger screens

Family Conversations is built on research in child development and family communication. Every question builds skills like counterfactual reasoning, autobiographical memory, values clarification, and identity formation.

Start tonight. One question is all it takes.
